title: Chapter 22: Indirect Regulation
abstract: This book chapter examines theoretical approaches for hedge fund regulation and emphasizes indirect regulatory means for the industry. The chapter shows that indirect regulation of the hedge fund industry attains most regulatory objectives while providing the industry with sufficient leeway.
